subject: NovaHealth MSA & Order Form — signature routing, signer authority, and final artifacts
messages:
From: Sofia Mathews <sofia.mathews@novahealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: NovaHealth MSA & Order Form — redlines and audit requests

Hi Marcus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the productive review yesterday. Attached are the redlines from our GC team (NovaHealth_MSA_redlines_20280501.docx) and the requested security appendix. A few items to flag up front so we can stay on the same timeline:

- We need countersignature on the MSA and the initial Order Form by 2028-05-10 to meet procurement cutoffs.
- Our legal team asked for explicit retention of the signing audit log for 7 years — can you confirm Redwood can provide DocuSign audit logs and an exported PDF of the envelope audit trail?
- Preferred signing flow: embedded signing for our primary signer (VP Procurement) and sequential for the finance approver.
- Please confirm who on Redwood will be the envelope owner and the exact signatory name/title we should expect.

If it helps, we can pre-populate the signatory block once you confirm email and title. Also attaching the security appendix for your infra team to verify.

Attachments: NovaHealth_MSA_redlines_20280501.docx (tracked changes), NovaHealth_Security_Appendix.pdf

Thanks,
Sofia Mathews
Senior Counsel, NovaHealth
sofia.mathews@novahealth.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Mathews <sofia.mathews@novahealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth MSA & Order Form — redlines and audit requests

Sofia — thanks for sending these over.

Plan and next steps from our side:
1) Legal review: looping in Karthik to confirm which redlines are deal-stoppers vs. negotiable. Karthik — can you scan and call out any must-fix language by EOD?
2) Execution flow: Vanessa will own DocuSign setup and routing. Vanessa — I want an envelope configured with: embedded signing for Nova's VP Procurement (as requested), then sequential to their finance rep, then countersign by Redwood’s authorized signatory. Please confirm recipient roles and the envelope owner email we should use.
3) Audit & retention: we will deliver the DocuSign audit log (CSV and PDF audit trail) and push final signed PDFs to a secure Drive folder and to Nova’s primary legal contact. We can also set S3 export if you prefer.
4) Clean copies: once signed, we'll generate a sealed-clean PDF (flattened, page-stamped) and include a separate envelope audit PDF. Expect final artifacts within 24 hours of last signature.

Karthik — tagging you for a redline summary and decision. Vanessa — please prepare a draft envelope and share link for review before sending.

Marcus Lin
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sofia Mathews <sofia.mathews@novahealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-01T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaHealth MSA & Order Form — redlines and audit requests

Marcus / Sofia — quick read of the tracked changes attached. High-level: most commercial redlines are acceptable; there are two negotiation items to resolve before we proceed to signature:

- Section 5.2 (Data retention): Nova's proposed 7-year preservation for audit logs is OK, but we need to ensure limited-scope language and reference to access controls — I propose the clause be amended to say "audit logs will be provided via secure export and retained for seven (7) years, subject to Redwood's standard data access controls and legal hold procedures."
- Section 9.1 (Indemnity carve-outs): need to preserve Redwood's existing carve-outs for third-party infra components. I can draft a narrow compromise paragraph.

If those two points are acceptable in principle, I'm happy to prepare a redline-summary (short memo) and a clean-for-signing PDF. I will also attach a suggested signature block language for Nova's countersigner to avoid mismatch.

I have uploaded a short redline_summary.docx to the shared drive (see link). Once Sofia confirms acceptance of the two alternate wordings, we can finalize and move to DocuSign.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Mathews <sofia.mathews@novahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: DocuSign envelope ready — please confirm recipient order and sign-by date

Hi Sofia — looping back with an operational update.

I created the DocuSign envelope and attached the clean-for-signing PDF and security appendix. Envelope details:
- Envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h (preview link: https://na2.docusign.net/envelope/details?envelopeId=0a1b2c3d4e5f6g7h)
- Documents: NovaHealth_MSA_clean_for_signing.pdf, Order_Form_V1.pdf, NovaHealth_Security_Appendix.pdf
- Recipient sequence: 1) VP Procurement (embedded) — sofia
  2) Finance Approver (sequential) — daniel.park@novahealth.com
  3) Redwood Authorized Signatory (final) — legal-sign@redwood.com (this will be Marcus's delegate)
- Audit & exports: envelope is configured to capture the DocuSign audit trail PDF and CSV; I will export both and place them in the Drive folder and email the CSV to your procurement contact.

Action items for Nova: please confirm the exact legal name and title for the VP Procurement recipient (we have "Janet Turner, VP Procurement" tentatively). We also need a sign-by date — is 2028-05-10 still required? If so, I'll set a reminder and an automatic expiration 48 hours afterwards.

Once the envelope completes, I will:
- Push final flattened PDFs + audit trail to the Drive folder (drive link above)
- Email sealed PDFs to the Nova legal mailbox and CC the procurement contact
- Upload the audit CSV to our internal retention bucket for 7-year exportability

Thanks — I can hold the envelope for 1 hour if you want to make any recipient edits before I send.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Contracts Program Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
